metadata.title: Tribal president and inauguration of Parliament | संसद भवन के उद्घाटन से वंचित आदिवासी राष्ट्रपति
metadata.description: n this highly anticipated YouTube interview, Mr Nand Kumar Sai, a prominent tribal leader and former member of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), provides valuable insights into the controversy surrounding the absence of President Droupadi Murmu from the inauguration ceremony of the new parliament building. As the first tribal woman president of the country, her exclusion from such a significant event has sparked a heated debate, leading to opposition parties announcing a boycott of the ceremony. Mr Sai, who has an extensive background in parliamentary affairs and firsthand experience within the BJP, offers a unique perspective on the matter.
